name: MenuPopup
description: Combines `Menu.PortalPrimitive`, `Menu.PositionerPrimitive`, and `Menu.PopupPrimitive` into a single part. Use `portalElement` or `positionerElement` to replace the portal or positioner. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: children
props.description: Menu items shown in the panel, such as `Menu.Item`, `Menu.Group`, or `Menu.Separator`.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: portalElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Menu.PortalPrimitive`. Use to change the portal container.

props.name: positionerElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Menu.PositionerPrimitive`. Use to change the side, alignment, or offset of the popup.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: finalFocus
props.detailedType: boolean | React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | ((closeType: "" | "mouse" | "touch" | "pen" | "keyboard") => (boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)) | undefined
props.description:
Determines the element to focus when the menu is closed.

- `false`: Do not move focus.
- `true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element).
- `RefObject`: Move focus to the ref element.
- `function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
  Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Menu.Popup.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
